matrix_name.name: polybenzoxazine
matrix_name.description: Thermosetting resin synthesized from benzoxazine monomer 2,2-bis(4-phenyl-3,4-dihydro-2H-1,3-benzoxazinyl)-isopropane (BA-a); cured at 140°C and 160°C for 2h each, then 180°C for 3h

fillers.name: graphene/nickel composite filler
fillers.description: Composite filler (GN) comprising 50 wt% graphene and 50 wt% nickel; graphene layers decorated with flower-shaped nickel particles ~100 nm in size; prepared by in-situ reduction of nickel ions in basic ethanol/water solution
